- **Selected Performance tags**: @PerformancePreps
- **Risk Level**: high
- **AI Confidence**: 100%

<details>
<summary>click to see 🤖 AI reasoning details</summary>

**E2E Test Selection:**
Hard rule (en-locale-change): locales/languages/en.json changed — UI strings and E2E text/label selectors may diverge (including platform casing like Android textAllCaps). Running all tests.

**Performance Test Selection:**
The usePerpsActivityQuery hook was significantly refactored: fills are now stored in page data and re-transformed via memo on aggregation toggle changes rather than being transformed during fetch. This architectural change to how Perps activity data is processed and rendered could affect the @PerformancePreps performance scenario which covers perps market loading, position management, add funds flow, and order execution. The refactoring moves fill transformation out of the fetch path and into a memo, which could impact rendering performance for the Perps activity list.

</details>
